blurb: Kitty Hawk Kites offers rentals of surfboards, skimboards, and beach cruiser bikes at multiple locations in the Outer Banks. They provide group activities including hang gliding, kayak eco-tours, kite making, and historical Wright Glider presentations. Rentals and adventures cater to all ages and skill levels with options for delivery and pickup.
extraNote: Full payment required 2 weeks prior to activity · $200 deposit required at booking, refundable up to 1 month prior · If activity cancelled by operator, refund or reschedule offered · Group discounts vary by activity and availability · No waiver signing for minors by trip planner; parent/legal guardian must sign in person · Kitty Hawk Kites locations in Corolla, Duck, Nags Head, Waves, and Hatteras
